Name: Aira's Cuter Fairies
Author: BlurryRed
Description:
[center][b][size=4] Features:[/size][/b][/center]
[center][b][size=4]A simple visual replacement to make fairies look more cuter[/size][/b][/center]
[center][b][size=4] [/size][/b][/center]
[center][size=4]Fairy Box Retexture[/size][/center]
[center][img width=169]https://staticdelivery.nexusmods.com/mods/1303/images/52171/52171-1789988901-470511038.png[/img][/center]
[center] [/center]
[center][b][size=4]Default Options:[/size][/b][/center]
[center][size=3]• 5 options for fairies[/size][/center]
[center][size=3](Holiday, Angel, Witch, Aqua, and Pastel)[/size][/center]
[center][img width=452]https://staticdelivery.nexusmods.com/mods/1303/images/52171/52171-1789985491-1054058787.gif[/img][/center]
[center] [/center]
[center][size=4][b]New Options:[/b][/size][/center]
[center]• 3 new options for fairies[/center]
[center](Florist, Steampunk, and Tropical)[/center]
[center][img width=454]https://staticdelivery.nexusmods.com/mods/1303/images/52171/52171-1789985495-684821918.gif[/img][/center]
[center][size=3](You can change it in-game using [b]Generic Mod Config Menu[/b])[/size][/center]
[center] [/center]
[center][b][size=4]Upcoming Features[/size][/b][/center]
[center]• Better animations[/center]
[center]• More options[/center]
[center] [/center]
[center][/center]
[b][size=4]Requirements: [/size][/b]
[url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/5098][size=2]Generic Mod Config Menu[/size][/url] - Optional but recommended for in-game customizations 
[url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/93]CJB Item Spawner[/url] - Optional but recommend for early fairy box item
[url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/4]CJB Cheats Menu[/url] - Optional but recommend for early mastery adjustments
[url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/1915]Content Patcher[/url] - Required
[url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/2400]SMAPI[/url] - Required
(Please make sure to download all the required files in order to make the mod work)

[b][size=4]Installation:[/size][/b]
1. Make sure you have the latest versions of [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/2400]SMAPI[/url] and [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/1915]Content Patcher[/url] installed. [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/5098]Generic Mod Config Menu[/url] and [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/4]CJB Cheats Menu[/url] is not required but I highly recommend it.
2. Unzip the folder into [font=Courier New]Stardew Valley/Mods[/font]
3. Run the game through the SMAPI launcher.
